tools.name: prep_describe
tools.description: Read the actual open GUI document, complete handle, capabilities and draft/busy status.

tools.name: prep_cards
tools.description: List the current GUI provider's objects with exact typed references. Do not invent references.

tools.name: prep_properties
tools.description: Read supported field values, kinds and unit choices for a typed reference from prep_cards.

tools.name: prep_selection
tools.description: Read the canonical selection currently displayed by the GUI.

tools.description: Select a real GUI object using the complete current handle; pending drafts are preserved and block selection.

tools.name: prep_edit_scalar
tools.description: Apply writable number/bool fields as one normal GUI command and one Undo step. Use advertised units; stale handles fail.

tools.name: prep_undo
tools.description: Undo the shared document's last command; requires the current handle and no pending GUI draft.

tools.name: prep_redo
tools.description: Redo the shared document's next command; requires the current handle and no pending GUI draft.

tools.name: prep_save
tools.description: Save the same open document as a .caeprep file at an explicit path; original solver inputs remain protected.

tools.name: prep_events
tools.description: Read owner session/job events after a sequence; recover an expired cursor with prep_describe.

tools.name: prep_mesh_start
tools.description: Start the existing GUI's real CAD mesh-candidate worker. Return workflow ID and private cancel capability; does not adopt a model.

tools.name: prep_job_get
tools.description: Query an existing GUI workflow's generation, real task status, assets and error; no cancellation credential is disclosed.

tools.name: prep_job_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation using the creator's workflow capability. Check the later actual status; atomic adoption cannot be cancelled.

tools.name: prep_job_close
tools.description: Close the creator's completed candidate window. Running tasks must finish or be cancelled first.
